_comments: No credentials are needed for SQLite.
IMPORTANT: The JDBC URL path is resolved relative to the working directory of the
connecting process. Always run the script from your project root, or use an
absolute path to avoid SQLite silently creating an empty database file.
Copy to your project root, rename to orm_skyway_config.json, and edit for your database.

Set 'embed_db_file_in_microservice' to true for a self-contained/shippable image (e.g. for demos or Glama certification). Default false = mount the SQLite directory at runtime so WAL files (db-wal, db-shm) are also accessible. The host DB directory is mounted at /opt/<image_name>/db inside the container.
